notes.title: Our Playtest is almost over!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

I really hope you've been having a great time playing our PLAYTEST! We've had loads of fun watching you explore and build, and we're so grateful for all your feedback and bug reports! 

The team have been hard at work fixing up and adding to Heist Simulator, and we're ALMOST ready to move on to the next phase for Heist Simulator! While we're not quite ready to talk about it yet, the next Heists adventure is right around the corner, so you won't have to wait long to take part! 

[b]What does this mean for you? Well...[/b]

[u]We'll be taking down the Playtest this Friday![/u] This isn't the last you'll hear of us before launch, so make sure you've got your eyes peeled here and on Steam for updates! 

While we're excited about what comes next, we want to make sure your levels are safe! So if you're attached to what you've built - here's how to find them to back them up! 

- Press Windows Key + R then put %userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\roguecode _ SkyBagel\Heist Simulator
- Inside that folder, there will be some folders with numbers (this is your steam user ID) 
- Select the folder that most recently changed. Inside that open Owned, and then inside that each folder is each campaign that you have made.
- Select these and copy them to a safe location. If Steam loses these for whatever reason, or you make changes that you didn't want, you can paste this back in to the same location to get your original levels back.
 
We can't wait to show you what's next - we'll see you there!!

notes.title: Heist Simulator lets you craft your own capers and share them with the world
notes.notes:
Heist Simulator has a plan. Look here. See that bit I’ve circled? That’s where your little team of reprobates break into a fancy mansion, or a bustling casino, and make off with the spoils. No fuss. Seems simple, yeah? Well, look over here. This is where the players will be able to set up the heists themselves. They create and publish their own missions, using complex tools to build the levels, hide the loot, and set traps. Not so simple after all. Things could get tougher than an overcooked steak that’s been marinated in diamonds.
